linkPanel.text:
## 🎮 Link your FiveM account

When you join the server without a link, a 4-letter code shows up on the connection screen. Click the button below, paste the code and you are done: then just reconnect.

oauth.notConfigured: OAuth is not configured on the server.
oauth.cancelled: Authorization cancelled on Discord. You can close this and use /link.
oauth.sessionExpired: Invalid or expired link session. Reconnect to FiveM and try again.
oauth.successHello: Hi, {user} — your Discord account was linked to your license.
oauth.successBack: Go back to FiveM: you'll get in automatically in a few seconds.
oauth.errorHint: You can go back to FiveM and use the {command} command with the code shown on screen.
oauth.tokenExchangeFailed: Failed to exchange the OAuth code with Discord.
oauth.userFetchFailed: Failed to fetch the user from Discord.
